C0547.title: Woman Arrested for Fraudulent Return Scam Using Package Swap Scheme
C0547.summary: On June 16, 2026, police exposed a case in which a woman used fake addresses and courier services to swap newly purchased items with old ones before requesting refunds. She was detained on suspicion of fraud.

references.title: Modus Operandi Exposed! Woman Maliciously Swapped and Returned Items for Refunds, Suspected of Fraud, Detained by Police
